attempts.reason: New rigorous reduction: a single log-normal smoothed prime sum bound implies RH.
Euler-product/AFE method reduces to unsolved hybrid large-value problem for dual Dirichlet polynomials
Gave a rigorous one-sided disk reformulation and proved RH⇒Li-positivity, but the RH-equivalent converse is untouched.
New conditional reduction via vanishing loci of normal functions; proof sketch given, hypothesis unproven.
Conditional reduction of codim-2 Hodge to torsion IJ on hyperplane sections; hypothesis too strong to be useful.
Rigorously recomputed λ_1>0 and sharpened the Li-positivity failure mode, but produced no new leverage on RH.
Proved a propagation lemma: algebraicity of flat Hodge classes under vanishing-(p,p) in vanishing cohomology
Conditional reduction of primitive HC to lower dim + AJ vanishing; obstruction remains.
Verified Φ's positivity and log-concavity, but proved this reduces to a Pólya total-positivity condition equivalent to RH.
Proved sharp lower bound for 1-term Nyman approximation; shows barrier for naive approach
Reduced RH to a strict o(T) zero-density bound past \(\sigma=1/2\); existing estimates miss the threshold.
Rigorously ruled out the naive Berry–Keating operator and localized RH's content in the S(T) fluctuation, but proved no new bound.
Proved a rigorous θ=1/2 barrier for mollified second moments, limiting classical RH approaches.
Contour-shift+explicit formula blocked by insufficient zero-density and functional-equation cancellations
Clarified NB criterion as L²-approximation of 1/ζ on the line; obstruction is equivalent to RH, no new bound proved.
Proved a rigorous L2 barrier: supercritical mollifiers (length >T^1/2) can’t approximate 1 beyond a fixed error.
Isolated sharp obstruction (non-concavity of log \Phi) blocking Fourier-positivity proofs of RH
Quantified that Li-coefficient positivity matches RH in difficulty (arithmetic term re-enters at order n log n); no new bound.
Proved a rigorous barrier: single short mollifiers can’t reach RH without new off-diagonal input.
Reduced full BSD (mod finite Sha) to non-degeneracy of p-adic height pairing; known only for rank \le1
Sharpened Li's criterion to the pinning |1−1/ρ|=1 and isolated the growth mechanism, but proved no unconditional bound on the zero sum.
New rigorous reduction: a concrete one-sided prime inequality implies RH via explicit formula.
Reduction circular; weighted Mertens hyp. equiv. to the strip, no new zero-free region obtained.
Rigorously computed archimedean kernel sign and reduced Weil positivity to one pole-vs-prime domination inequality, unproven.
Rigorous barrier for single-piece mollifiers shows why this method alone cannot prove RH or >50% zeros.
Explicit elementary zero-free region of width 1/(log T log log T) obtained; method saturates and cannot reach Re=1/2.
Rigorously reproduced the Li/Bombieri–Lagarias equivalence with a quantitative off-line estimate, but achieved no new progress toward RH.
Reduction: RH iff a single explicit smoothed prime sum has O(X^{1/2+ε}) error; proof via explicit formula.
Conditional short-interval zero-density bound under weak prime hypothesis; bottleneck is arithmetic, not analytic.
Rederived λ₁>0 (necessary condition) and pinpointed the archimedean-vs-oscillatory obstruction in Li's criterion; no new progress on RH.
Rigorous barrier: low-degree correlation proofs are natural, thus blocked under PRG assumptions.
Mollified explicit formula gives only classical zero-free width; density gap blocks RH.
Rigorous proof of RH⇒Li-positivity with explicit nonneg form; converse obstruction localized to uniform oscillatory-sum domination.
Rigorous reduction: uniform sup-norm 1/ζ-approximation by Dirichlet polynomials implies RH; obstacle identified.
Reduction to truncated Weil positivity is circular (needs mult. bounds ~ RH) and gives weaker regions than classical.
Clean reproof of Li's criterion via the exact invariant |1-1/ρ|=1⟺Re ρ=½, but no new arithmetic input; RH untouched.
Proved a rigorous obstruction: Re(−ζ′/ζ) on Re s=1/2 kills off-line zero info even after smoothing.
Positivity criterion via Weil is valid but support obstruction renders it non-effective for off-line zeros
Rigorously quantified archimedean kernel in Weil positivity, but the low-frequency negativity vs. prime sum gap is exactly RH itself.
Proved a rigorous lower bound showing a concrete mollifier-length barrier (T^(1/2)) for an L^2 approach.
Proved HC for all smooth projective X with dim \le 3 via Lefschetz (1,1) + hard Lefschetz
Proved only the known fixed-exponent bound NP≠DTIME(n^k) and diagnosed why diagonalization cannot reach P≠NP.
Gave a rigorous reduction: sub–x^1/2 bounds for fixed-log smoothing imply RH
Classical 3-4-1 proof that \(\zeta\) has no zeros on Re(s)=1; no advance on the critical line.
Proved off-line pair drives some λ_n<0 (exponential beats polynomial); isolated finite off-line zeros excluded, infinite-conspiracy case open.
Proved an L2 Möbius criterion implying no zeros for Re s>1/2, a concrete conditional path to RH.
Weil positivity blocked by uncontrollable sign-indefinite prime sums; no new zero-free region obtained
Rigorously reconfirmed λ₁>0 and pinpointed Li-criterion's non-compactness obstruction, but produced no uniform bound.
Proved a rigorous obstruction: smoothing cannot create a mass gap; clarifies limits of a common tactic.
Local isolation of off-line zeros via weighted explicit formula; no global RH.
